summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, an obfuscated bootstrap (hex-mangled identifiers hiding fs/https/execFileSync imports and the download URL) that fetches the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun) into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it against a bundled math_init.js file. math_init.js is a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style blob (hex-named identifiers, ~1300-entry string/number decoder array, rotator function that shifts the array on each call) shipped inside the package tarball. Executing a 700+ KB obfuscated sibling script under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a React Native UI component kit). The alternate-runtime invocation pattern is used to evade Node-only supply-chain scanners; the bootstrap obfuscation hides the install-time command surface from static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
